scope: Read-only static peer review; no replay, model call, runner execution, private owner file read or source edit.
checks: Fixed external registration/publication pins precede approved-file and registered-source hash verification
Generated original owner serializer bytes match registered owner JSON SHA without opening private owner JSON
Public task conditions, seed, task version, split hashes and original test value SHA are linked
AST execution is confined to definitions/expressions from externally pinned trusted source bytes
Relocated path guard rejects outside-root, traversal, drive-relative, alternate streams and symlink evidence
limitations: This is a trust boundary for fixed source bytes, not a sandbox for arbitrary untrusted AST code

Resource totals are independently recalculated over the mutually checked response/resource-audit inventories; completeness of those inventories inherits the original pinned owner audit rather than rediscovering every request directory in the publication manifest
No actual resource accounting mismatch was established by this read-only review
Historical report-review status is checked, without fresh semantic adjudication or superiority/adoption assertion
